text:
Maria Chen: Quick signal — allocator pools in us-west-2 prod dropped the GPU label twice overnight; GitOps re-applied and we saw node churn + spot fallback spike.

Jasper Li: Seen the grafana chart, spike around 03:12 and 07:05. https://grafana.redwood/board/d/allocs

Tony Ramirez: Can we backfill nodes before GitOps flips more? The churn is causing pod evictions.

Sarah Nguyen: Looks like a TF partial apply during last maintenance left nodepool labels nil. Terraform plan shows the label removal for module.gke.nodepool[2].

Maria Chen: I ran a quick targeted plan to confirm: 
```
# terraform plan -target=module.gke.module.nodepool["gpu"]
~ module.gke.module.nodepool["gpu"].resource "google_container_node_pool" "primary" {
  labels = {
-   "gpu_enabled" = "true"
+   "gpu_enabled" = null
  }
}
```

Jasper Li: So GitOps overlay (helm values) was setting it, TF state drifted. Two sources of truth.

Olivia Park: Proposal: 1) Pause GitOps reconcile for nodepool labels for 15m, 2) Run TF apply targeted fix, 3) Backfill existing nodes with labels, 4) Re-enable GitOps in canary mode.

Tony Ramirez: +1. Also add an OPA gate to prevent deletion of gpu_enabled label in future PRs.

sre-bot: :robot_face: Creating incident "allocator-label-drift" and paging oncall. Reconcile job queued (id=rc-3948).

Jasper Li: I'll take the TF apply. Maria — can you pause the GitOps job? Sarah — can you draft the OPA snippet?

Maria Chen: Paused the `clusters/prod/nodepools` sync for 20m. :white_check_mark:

Sarah Nguyen: Draft OPA policy: 
```
package nodepool

deny[msg] {
  input.resource.kind == "NodePool"
  not input.resource.spec.labels["gpu_enabled"]
  msg = "nodepool must have gpu_enabled label"
}
```

Tony Ramirez: Backfill one-liner for nodes (use with care):
```
kubectl get nodes -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.labels["gpu-enabled"]!="true") | .metadata.name' | xargs -r -n1 kubectl label node gpu-enabled=true
```

Olivia Park: After TF apply I'll run a 5% traffic canary to the standby pool to validate no evictions.

Maria Chen: TF apply completed on targeted nodepool. State now shows gpu_enabled=true. Rolling update finished.

sre-bot: Reconcile job rc-3948 finished: no further diffs for targeted resources.

Tony Ramirez: Running backfill now.

Tony Ramirez: Backfill complete — 46 nodes labeled. Observed no evictions during 10m canary. :tada:

Jasper Li: Nice work. Follow-ups: convert gpu label to an annotation or add an enforcement check in reconcile pipeline to auto-backfill small diffs. Also file a GH issue to align TF <> GitOps for nodepool tags.

Olivia Park: I'll open the GH issue and schedule a 2-hour maintenance window next Tue to run full reconciliation tests. Assigning infra team.

Maria Chen: Thanks everyone. Closing incident if no regressions in 24h.

sre-bot: Incident "allocator-label-drift" status: resolved — monitoring for 24h.
